title: Introduction To Metaphysics

mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the method through which metaphysics gain knowledge of reality without reference to experience."
The A priori Method The a priori method is the method through which metaphysics gain knowledge of reality without reference to experience.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fundamental building block of matter is a position arrived at rationally without any empirical proof as quarks have defied empirical verification."
Even scientists' claim that quark is the fundamental building block of matter is a position arrived at rationally without any empirical proof as quarks have defied empirical verification.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a metaphysical study of the human person."
Philosophical anthropology is a metaphysical study of the human person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are described as things of worth or things that are good."
Values are described as things of worth or things that are good.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the claim that the universe was continually expanding and increasing in size."
An important conclusion of Lemaitre's discovery is the claim that the universe was continually expanding and increasing in size.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the unmoved mover who constitutes all that is, and He persists eternally."
God is the unmoved mover who constitutes all that is, and He persists eternally.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the subject matter of metaphysics."
Recall here that Being is the subject matter of metaphysics.
